orgDesign.companyProfile: Illustrative operating model for the reference domain: nine focused teams, 81 team FTE plus six group-leadership FTE. This is not Studytube's actual organization or headcount; corporate sales, HR, legal and finance functions are outside the modeled software and service scope.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Stream-aligned teams own learner, qualification, knowledge and training-procurement outcomes. Platform teams own measurement, integration and common assurance. An enabling service team owns implementation/support tooling and the customer handover. Each brick has exactly one primary owner in brickDependencies; cross-team consumption uses otherTeamDependencies. AI appears as a governed product capability, not an autonomous staff role.
